note: Frozen in Generation 0 (SPEC 7.5, Article 11). Strategies cannot alter these.

fill_rules.market: next bar open plus slippage against the order
fill_rules.stop: triggered when the bar trades at the stop price; fills at stop plus slippage against, or at the bar open plus slippage against if the bar opens beyond the stop
fill_rules.limit_entry: filled only if the bar trades through the limit by at least 1 tick; fills at the limit price
fill_rules.profit_target: filled only if the bar trades through the target by at least 1 tick; fills at the target price
fill_rules.entry_bar: the stop is assumed hit if reachable in the entry bar; a limit or stop entry cannot reach its target in the entry bar
fill_rules.session_gap: a stop gapped through fills at the open
fill_rules.thin_bar: fill refused when bar volume is below 20 times order quantity; logged as a liquidity miss
fill_rules.session_end: INTRADAY_FLAT forces flat on the session's last bar at its close minus slippage
